answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in onyx, expire in signal, and copper lists each expiry. Anyone running 76 aliases as a result needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1314 identities would post 1620 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
